usage: Agreeing freely or acting by choice.
Acceptance despite difficulty, fear, discomfort, or cost.
Used for quantity, adequacy, or satisfaction.
Also used to express pleasure or willingness in polite speech.
exEn: I am happy to help you.

english: long for; yearn for; strongly desire
usage: Stronger and more emotional than xav ('want').

english: be alert; be careful; pay attention
usage: Warning, awareness, and vigilance.
why: not in the dictionary; 'be careful / watch out' is already there as 'ceev faj' (misc-ceev-faj) — possibly a typo or variant; author to confirm

usage: More formal than a casual warning.
Literally 'hold/grasp words'; used for promises.
ex: Nws cog lus tias nws yuav los.
exEn: He/she promised that they would come.

usage: Often used for responsibility, fault, or truth.
ex: Nws lees tias nws ua txhaum.
exEn: He/she admitted that they were wrong.

usage: Used for permission, rights, or official approval.
ex: Lawv tso cai rau kuv mus.
exEn: They gave me permission to go.

usage: Can be an action or the restriction itself.
ex: Txwv tsis pub haus luam yeeb.

usage: Opposite direction from yeem/kam: action without freely given willingness.
Can be neutral, affectionate, or manipulative depending on context.
Often advice or urging, less coercive than yuam.
Often used for a firm or consequential decision.
why: headword and example disagree — the example uses 'txiav txim siab' for 'decide'. Imported AS 'txiav txim siab'; 'ntxim siab' itself held for the author

usage: Often used for a firm or consequential decision.

english: work hard; labor; earn a living
usage: More than simply 'do work'; often suggests sustained effort.
exEn: He/she works to earn money every day.

usage: Literally 'hot heart'; strong motivation or effort.
Ability to bear pain, stress, weather, or pressure.
Used for forgiveness or an apology.
